proof_audit.information_and_domain: Observed finite positive Markov productivity with exogenous known transition law; predetermined capital and adapted current choices. Household individual asset versus aggregate capital distinguished. Full-depreciation proof domain separate from general partial-depreciation interior necessities and local diagnostics.
proof_audit.planner_exact: Static maximization over saving is strictly concave with negative-infinite endpoints; remaining labor log terms strictly concave give n. B log k coefficient and finite-vector A equation derived correctly. Finite-vector geometric convergence does not assert unbounded-function sup-norm contraction. Candidate log recursion is uniformly bounded; every feasible competitor has bounded positive utility parts through bounded capital, making objective limits legitimate.
proof_audit.global_verification: Joint concavity of Cobb-Douglas and log consumption/leisure gives tangent inequality. Candidate labor term cancels, conditional Euler cancels adapted interior capital differences, and alternative nonnegative capital leaves beta^T s/q. Finite branching and bounded candidate prices ensure finite-date integrability. Retaining one positive-probability strict utility tangent gap establishes consumption/labor uniqueness; strict monotonicity excludes resource disposal and resources fix capital. Null histories appropriately excluded.
proof_audit.competitive: CRS and concavity imply firm global optimum and zero profit at marginal prices, without claiming unique firm scale. Initial capital and firm shares are owned; households face linear budgets and aggregate prices exogenously. Candidate asset path has bounded prices; deviating assets/consumption grow at most exponentially, so positive log parts are discounted summable. Same tangent/Euler/nonnegative-asset tail proves separate household optimality. Factor and goods markets clear with zero dividends; no idiosyncratic market completeness claim.
proof_audit.local: Steady rental, capital/hours ratio, resources and chi calibration are correct. Intratemporal labor coefficient1/(1-n) and Euler beta*r share correct. Independently reduced capital/consumption transition yields stable/unstable roots and shock loading; manuscript quadratic expansion and denominator agree. Local algebra/stability only, no nonlinear existence or global welfare certificate inferred. Both future shock branches share predetermined capital in exact conditional residuals.
proof_audit.stationary: Bounded two-sided Markov-shock series defines a stationary state. Same-shock initial difference contracts; corrected finite-chain forgetting and uniform series-tail argument establish joint-law convergence for arbitrary initial productivity. Covariance recursions and lag relation follow by conditioning. Output/consumption/investment exact log identities yield ratios; constant labor has undefined correlation, correctly distinguished from zero correlation.
proof_audit.cap_and_measurement: Binding cap has positive labor multiplier and nonpositive feasible labor term; Euler/shadow-tail verification survives. Utilization counterexamples satisfy measurement identity and service feasibility but are explicitly not alternative equilibrium constructions. Calibrated targets separated from held-out moments, causal identification and conditional welfare claims.
